poll_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between polls for device-mapper events. Configurable via LVM poll_interval setting. Default derived from lvm.conf(5).

dbus_socket.description: Path to D-Bus system socket for event subscription. Default is /run/dbus/system_bus_socket per dmeventd configuration. Leave empty to disable D-Bus.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads to handle concurrent events. 0 means auto-determined.

log_level.description: Verbosity level controlled via -d flag in man page. 0=no debug, 1-3 increasing verbosity. Default 0 = no debug output.

pid_file.description: Absolute path to the PID file for the dmeventd daemon.

log_file.description: Absolute path to a log file. Empty means logs only to syslog/journald. Use -l flag to log to stdout/stderr.

background_processing.description: When true, events are processed asynchronously in background threads. Use -f flag to override and run in foreground.

targets.description: Monitoring targets configured via LVM plugins (mirror, raid, snapshot, thin, vdo). Default empty list - targets configured via lvm.conf(5). Each item contains: name, path, polling_enabled, event_types.
